collected_dynamic_variables.pain_points: missed calls, callers hang up, too many calls to track

transcript:
User: Hey! So I'm Sofia — I run a real estate office here in Houston. Your ad was talking about missed calls? That's literally me.
Agent: Got it, Sofia — missed calls are literally you, that makes total sense in real estate. When a call comes in and you or your team can’t grab it, what usually happens to that caller — voicemail, missed entirely, or something else?
User: Voicemail mostly, but sometimes they just hang up. I can't even track how many! Maybe 25? Or 30?
Agent: Mhm, yeah, that’s a lot — 25–30 a week you don’t really know what happens to. When those calls slip through to voicemail or hang up, what do you feel like you’re losing most — new listings, buyer leads, or just general opportunities?
User: Definitely missing out on new listings and buyer leads. It's chaos! Do you have a solution for this?
Agent: Yeah, that chaos is exactly what we focus on — stopping those missed listings and buyer leads from slipping away. Before I jump into how we fix it, has anyone ever walked you through the actual numbers of what those missed calls are costing you each week?
User: No, never crunched the numbers. I'm sure it's huge. I'm busy next week... actually, tomorrow works. Tell me more!
Agent: Makes sense, and yeah, it’s usually bigger than people think. So ballpark for your world — of those 25–30 calls that hit voicemail or hang up in a week, what percentage do you feel would turn into a real listing or buyer if you actually answered… maybe half?
User: Oh, for sure! Half at least. I mean, 25. This service sounds perfect. Tell me more!
Agent: Got it — at least half, and about 25 a week. And when one of those does turn into a real client, what’s that worth to you on average — commission-wise, are we talking more like $3,000, $5,000, $8,000 per deal?
User: Oh, usually around $5,000 per deal. But it can reach $8,000 sometimes. Depends on the property.
Agent: Right, that makes sense — $5k a deal, sometimes $8k, adds up fast when those calls slip. So… to make sure I set this up right for you, what’s your last name, Sofia?
User: Sure, it's Sofia Martinez, and my brokerage is Martinez Realty Group. So what exactly does your service include?
Agent: Got it, Sofia Martinez at Martinez Realty Group — thank you. So… at a high level, our service makes sure when you or your agents miss a call, it still turns into a booked appointment or qualified lead instead of a dead voicemail; when a call comes in and you’re busy, would you rather it automatically books a consult, captures lead details, or routes to the right agent first?
User: Book a consult automatically. I need those appointments secured! This is exactly what I need.
Agent: Perfect, that makes total sense — automatic consult booking so those listing and buyer calls don’t slip away. And… is the number you’re calling from right now the best contact number to reach you?
User: Yes, this number works. But wait! What's the timezone for our call? I'm in Mountain—oh no, Central.
Agent: Got it, Central time in Houston — perfect. Since this is the best number, what’s the actual 10-digit phone number so we can text you the confirmation for the call with Jay?
User: Oh, sure! It's 555-0182. Looking forward to hearing from Jay. Can you confirm the time again?
Agent: Yeah, looking forward to it too. For tomorrow, I can get you in at either 10:00 or 10:45 Central for that 20‑minute call with Jay — which works better for you?
User: Let's do 10:45 Central. Perfect! Thanks. Can you re-confirm it? I changed my mind earlier, just want to be sure.
Agent: Got it, tomorrow at 10:45 Central with Jay is what we’re aiming for. Oh sorry, I didn’t get your number quite right - could you verify it real quick, including area code?
User: Oh, my bad! It's 713-555-0182. Looking forward to the call with Jay. Thanks!
Agent: One moment while I confirm that.
Agent: One moment while I confirm that.
Agent: So, Sofia, it looks like the calendar’s having trouble confirming your number on our side. We’ll give you a call at 713-555-0182 within the hour to lock in tomorrow at 10:45 Central with Jay. Is there anything else you need from me before we hang up? Really glad you called — talk soon!
